correctness.rationale: Reconstructed t=S/h reduced recurrence u_{k+1}=u_k²+v_k², v_{k+1}=u_kv_k, gcd invariance and square criterion Q_{k+1}=(u_{k-1}+v_{k-1})²/gcd(h,u_k). Odd p divisibility excludes numerator factor; p=2 valuation exactly one. A prime divides u_k at most once after v_{k+1}=0 mod p. Only starts with v_p(x0)=v_p(h) can fail. For p≡13,17 mod20, -5 is nonsquare and no rational second preimages; p=5 has two one-step and two two-step preimages, no later; p≡3 mod4 inert; CRT yields four densities. Independently evaluated original rational recurrence for all 4225 residue starts h=65 with observed counts (3507,380,334,4), not extrapolated as infinite proof.
residual_risks: Computer checks are limited to the explicitly recorded finite cases; the unrestricted result rests on the reconstructed analytic proof, not extrapolation.
